data.one_liner: A customizable, dismissible, and animated flushbar and toast widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: FlashyFlushbar provides animated toast and snackbar notifications for Flutter applications. It supports entrance and exit transitions, leading and trailing custom widgets, and programmatic control to show or cancel messages.
use_when: You need customizable snackbars or toasts with animations in your Flutter app.
You want a flushbar that can be dismissed or cancelled programmatically.
avoid_when: You need persistent system notifications instead of in-app toasts.
You are looking for a complete UI component kit rather than single-purpose notifications.
strengths: Supports cancelling specific or all active flushbars.
weaknesses: Requires adding FlashyFlushbarProvider in the app builder for context access.
data.setup_notes: Requires initializing FlashyFlushbarProvider.init() in the builder of your MaterialApp.

alternatives.name: fluttertoast
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want simple native-looking toasts across platforms without context.

alternatives.name: another_flushbar
alternatives.why_pick_it: For a more mature alternative flushbar implementation.

alternatives.name: toastification
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need modern, highly stylized toast notifications with rich configuration options.
